name: ABL proto-oncogene 1, non-receptor tyrosine kinase

function.text: ABL1 encodes tyrosine-protein kinase ABL1. Annotated molecular activities include kinase activity and protein kinase activity. It participates in mismatch repair and intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to congenital heart defects and skeletal malformations syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Acute myeloid leukemia; Chronic myeloid leukemia; B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
